relations: The upper platform driven by the metal ram moves downward, narrowing the gap between the two striped platforms.
The narrowing gap compresses the ball, causing its vertical height to shrink while its sides bulge outward.

The fixed camera viewpoint holds the deforming ball centered throughout the continuous compression process.
caption: The video depicts a white soccer ball with black star-patterned panels clamped between two yellow-and-black striped platforms, the upper one driven by a polished metal press ram. The setup sits on an orange-topped stand against a plain beige wall with a small hole, beside a fixed circular pressure-gauge inset in the top-right corner. The metal cylinder and top platform move steadily downward, narrowing the gap between the platforms. The ball's vertical height shrinks while its sides bulge outward, its profile flattening and widening under the load. Stitched seams and printed panels warp with the deformation, yet the ball neither bursts nor collapses. The lower platform, orange base, wall, and gauge inset stay in place, so the visible change is the ball deforming rather than the camera moving. The compression progresses continuously throughout, with no release or rupture shown. The viewpoint remains fixed, holding the deforming ball centered.
